info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Events Ticketing Tickets Resales-v5-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Resale Listing API facilitates the retrieval of available tickets for resale across various events. This endpoint allows developers to access data about tickets that users wish to sell, enhancing the visibility of resale options for potential buyers. Typical consumers include ticketing platforms and resale applications, which leverage this data to provide users with comprehensive listings of tickets on the secondary market. By offering an easy means to check available resale tickets, this API directly supports event-goers in finding their desired tickets efficiently.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of tickets that are currently available for resale. It provides details on various tickets, including their availability and pricing, helping users to make informed purchasing decisions.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving resale ticket information. This should include all necessary parameters to filter and fetch the desired ticket resale data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of resale tickets.
